entry.title: Rising voice AI adoption creates new hiring demand for FDEs
entry.summary: Globally, job postings for Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) rose 729% year-on-year between April 2025 and April 2026, according to Indeed data. In India, postings surged 1,807% YoY in June 2026.

entry.title: Helsing built an AI system that prepares targets for weapons systems and says every decision will carry a human name
entry.summary: Helsing has unveiled Clarity, an AI platform that uses agents to distill sensor data into target recommendations for weapons systems, all under human oversight and European control. But experience from the Iran war, Gaza, and a near-miss involving China shows that the speed of automation and data fusion create risks that are hard to contain.
